title.original: Automated Planning for Optimal Data Pipeline Instantiation
title.zh: 优化数据管道实例化的自动化规划
title.en: Automated Planning for Optimal Data Pipeline Instantiation

venue: Proceedings of the ECAI Workshop on AI-based Planning for Complex Real-World Applications (CAIPI 2025)

inclusion_reason.zh: 该规划器将算子、资源和链路代价统一为可执行部署计划，为数据流水线提供可复用的集群实例化控制面。
inclusion_reason.en: The planner turns operators, resources, and link costs into executable deployment plans, providing a reusable control plane for instantiating data pipelines.

abstract.zh: 该工作把数据流水线部署建模为带动作代价的自动规划问题，使系统可在算子需求、通信开销和执行时间之间搜索资源分配方案。
abstract.en: This work formulates data-pipeline deployment as cost-sensitive automated planning, enabling a search over resource assignments that accounts for operator requirements, communication, and execution overhead.

problem.zh: 流水线框架能抽象算子逻辑，却仍需决定算子放在哪些集群资源上；不恰当的部署会同时放大数据传输和计算等待。
problem.en: Pipeline frameworks abstract operator logic but still must place operators on cluster resources, where poor placement can amplify both data movement and compute delay.

approach.zh: 作者将资源、算子与部署动作编码为规划状态和带成本动作，并设计多种启发式函数以近似最小化端到端执行时间。
approach.en: The authors encode resources, operators, and deployment choices as planning states and weighted actions, then design heuristics that approximate minimum end-to-end execution time.

system_design.zh: 规划器读取算子依赖图、执行需求和集群连接信息，评估候选放置动作的通信与计算代价，最终输出可实例化的部署计划。
system_design.en: The planner consumes the operator DAG, execution requirements, and cluster connectivity, scores placement actions by communication and compute cost, and emits an executable deployment plan.

key_results.zh: 所提启发式部署方案优于基线，其中显式利用连接关系的启发式在比较中表现最好。
key_results.en: The proposed heuristic deployments outperform the baseline, with the connectivity-aware heuristic performing best among the strategies compared.

limitations.zh: 规划质量依赖执行和网络代价估计的准确性；模型未必覆盖突发负载、运行时故障或数据倾斜，较大流水线还可能遭遇搜索空间膨胀。
limitations.en: Plan quality depends on accurate runtime and network cost estimates; bursty workloads, failures, and skew may violate the model, while larger DAGs can expand the search space sharply.

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件与基线均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未给出可安全转录的结果数字，表格明细与部署配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, and baselines come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; the abstract provides no result number safe to transcribe, and table details plus deployment configuration still require full-text audit.
